audience: businesses that take online bookings through Booxi

useCases.title: Check the services and staff a business offers online
useCases.text: List the services that are open for online booking, with their price and duration. Then list the staff who offer one of them.

useCases.title: Find the first open slot for an appointment
useCases.text: Find the first open time of each service in a window of up to 31 days. For a booking with several services, search their open slots together.

useCases.title: Review the group classes and workshops in a date range
useCases.text: List the group events that start in a range of up to 180 days. Open one event to see its time, price, location, staff and places.

useCases.title: Check the price or duration changes for a service
useCases.text: List the customizations that change the price or duration of a service or a staff member, and compare them with the service list.

useCases.title: Read the business profile and its service categories
useCases.text: Get the name, address, contact details and tags of the business. List its service categories to group the services.
